name: Ulf
site: netcologne.de · Home internet and fibre, Germany
headline: Turn NetCologne’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells fibre and DSL tariffs, top offers and the recommendation bonus to every visitor the same way, whether they want a new contract, a move or an address check.

The signal you already own is what customers do after they sign: which speed they change, which fault they report, when they log in. That signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upgrade and retention campaigns are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to cancel this week gets the same tariff mail as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from speed changes, fault reports and login gaps. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each line and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Move the right customers to fibre
cases.text: Next best tariff or add-on per customer, triggered by what they use. A DSL customer in a fibre expansion area hears about fibre, and nobody gets a blanket tariff mail.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every household online and in use
cases.text: Personal nudges for the services each household already has, such as Wi-Fi help or a speed check, triggered when usage drops. Each customer gets one reason to stay active.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
